title: Handling Medical Emergencies Abroad
description: Quy trình xử lý cấp cứu y tế ở nước ngoài: bảo hiểm, liên hệ lãnh sự và bệnh viện.

coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Comprehensive travel medical insurance is the single most vital purchase.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: sự sơ tán, đưa đi cấp cứu
coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Medical evacuation coverage transports patients home during catastrophic accidents.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: sự hoàn tiền, thanh toán bồi hoàn
coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Retain all hospital invoices and discharge papers to claim insurance reimbursement.

transcript.en: Welcome to Oxford Online English, providing critical safety guidance for global explorers.

transcript.en: Always double-check luggage dimensions and weight allowances before arriving at the departure station.
